thread:
people-ops: Heads-up  please welcome Nikhil Rao joining Redwood Inference as Head of Data & Analytics, start date 2026-10-05. Nikhil will centralize telemetry, cost analytics, and the internal data product used by Platform and Sales. We'll convert one contract DataOps role and open two backfills (Senior Data Engineer, Analytics PM). :tada:

Aisha Patel: Huge welcome Nikhil! Quick hiring note  we'll run internal-first referrals for the two backfills for 4 business days. I'll post req owners + HC codes by EOD.

Nikhil Rao: Super excited to join the team. First priorities: (1) ship a unified signals schema for inference telemetry, (2) stabilize billing reconciliations & unit-cost dashboards, (3) kick off a pilot for ML-derived alert prioritization. Happy to meet teams next week for 15m syncs.

Eva Martins: Welcome Nikhil! For the DataOps conversion  can we lock the contractor now? They've been driving our ETL infra. Also, is the Analytics PM role product-facing or infra-facing?

people-ops: Eva  contractor conversion approved (DATA-OPS-900). Analytics PM is product-facing (PM-DATA-412) focused on internal dashboards & sales-facing metrics. Senior Data Engineer is backfill (ENG-DATA-210).

Diego Morales: Great hire  we'll need a customer-impact note for key accounts that rely on billing exports. Nikhil  please flag any data migrations that might touch exports within your first 30 days.

Nikhil Rao: Will do Diego. I'll avoid any exports migration until we've validated parity. Plan to publish a migration playbook and a compatibility checklist in week 2.

Omar Singh: Headcount question  are these net-new or reallocated? Finance needs headcount mapping for Q4.

people-ops: Omar  Senior Data Engineer is a backfill (reallocated). Analytics PM is a newly approved slot. HC codes: ENG-DATA-210 (backfill), PM-DATA-412 (new), DATA-OPS-900 (conversion).

Aisha Patel: Interview plan: internal referrals 4 business days, then external. Loop: 1) quick internal screen, 2) technical deep-dive (for Eng), 3) product deep-dive (for PM), 4) cross-functional bar-raise panel. HiringBot  create GH openings and set referral window.

HiringBot: Reminder: create Greenhouse jobs with tags "data-analytics" and "billing-telemetry". Set internal referral window to 4 business days. Rubrics due: 2026-08-15.

Eva Martins: For the Senior Data Eng role please include a short take-home on schema migration (30-45m) and a systems design deep-dive focusing on streaming ETL and data quality checks.

Nikhil Rao: Agreed. Also prioritize candidates with experience building cost & usage pipelines for high-cardinality workloads. We need someone who can optimize aggregation latency and storage costs.

Diego Morales: For onboarding please add a "billing exports preservation" checklist. Link to onboarding: https://redwood.company/onboarding/data-analytics. Nikhil  please add your 30/60/90 there.

Aisha Patel: Comp note: Head of Data & Analytics = L6. Contractor conversion comp will follow contractor conversion guidelines; people-ops will prepare offers.

Omar Singh: One ask  let's freeze any schema changes in telemetry during the first month of Nikhil's start to avoid churn.

Nikhil Rao: Agree  propose freeze 2026-10-05 to 2026-11-05 for non-critical schema changes. I'll publish a list of allowed emergency changes and contact points.

people-ops: Action items: Aisha to post req owners + HC codes; HiringBot to create GH openings and remind teams for rubrics; Nikhil to publish 30/60/90 and migration playbook by 2026-10-12; Diego to draft customer note if exports are affected. Welcome Nikhil! :confetti_ball:
